name: Gil's Big Flop [Rage Game]
desc:
Group: https://www.roblox.com/share/g/4952414

Gil is a rubber fish with one big dream: to flop all the way home.

Hold to bend the diving board, let go to launch, then tap again in mid-air to FLOP. Land on the target and stay put until the ring fills.

- 5 speedruns of 40 levels each
- The original 40 levels in 5 zones: Toy Shop Shelf, Boardwalk Picnic, Lighthouse Workshop, Rainy Rooftops and Cloud Bathtub
- 5 bonus levels in The Deep End
- Wobbly fish physics
- Unlock paint colors and hats by making progress
- Run timer, personal bests and a leaderboard for every speedrun
- Play on computer, phone, tablet or controller

No loot boxes and no random rewards.
